I added `POST /api/patients/search` in `src/app/api/patients/search/route.ts`. It takes `{ "q": "..." }` in the JSON body, so the name never appears in the URL or Apache log. It is POST-only, because a GET would have put the name in the query string.

Only practitioners can call it; other roles get 403. A `q` shorter than 2 characters returns 400. Results are limited to the practitioner's own practice and capped at 20. The new query is `searchPatientsByName` in `src/repos/patients.ts`. It matches first or last name anywhere in the name, case-insensitively, and escapes `%` and `_` in the input.

The existing tests and typecheck pass, but I didn't write tests for the new endpoint. The search covers the whole practice, as the task says, and doesn't restrict results to the practitioner's care team.
